Maya (Partnerships): heads-up from GCP partner ops: several enterprise customers see doubled usage lines this morning. they think its coming from the SI who introduced a proxy sku. can someone triage?
Rishi (Billing): seeing duplicate debit rows for a handful of accounts. one row maps to sku 'redwood-api' and another to 'redwood-api-proxy' but both resolve to same internal entitlement_id for some customers.
Diego (Marketplace Integrations): quick theory: our sku normalization does prefix-match, so when SI added suffix '-proxy' we started mapping both SKUs to the same entitlement for orgs that had the legacy mapping. new accounts get separate entitlements.
Maya (Partnerships): ok. what is the blast radius?
Diego (Marketplace Integrations): running a scan now across yesterday's ingestion window (2025-11-02 00:00-02:00 UTC).
Marketplace Bot: scan started by @Diego (Marketplace Integrations) \u2014 job id mkt-scan-1792500001
Diego (Marketplace Integrations): repro SQL i ran:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, external_sku, internal_entitlement_id, count(*) as rows
FROM marketplace_raw_events
WHERE received_at BETWEEN '2025-11-02T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-11-02T02:00:00Z'
AND external_sku LIKE 'redwood-api%'
GROUP BY customer_id, external_sku, internal_entitlement_id
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Diego (Marketplace Integrations): results: 9 customers have both skus mapped to the same entitlement_id, 23 customers have separate entitlement_ids (expected).
Rishi (Billing): preliminary impact: 9 customers, total candidate credit ~ $8,340 (mostly monthly committed deals, so sensitive).
Eve (Compliance): if credits are issued we should use wording "usage alignment adjustment" and get approvals for anything > $5k per customer.
Maya (Partnerships): agreed. Diego, can you patch mapping rule to prefer exact-match over prefix and redeploy to canary? we need to stop new duplicates.
Diego (Marketplace Integrations): yes. plan:
1) change normalization to require exact SKU->entitlement mappings; fallback to explicit config otherwise
2) deploy to canary (canary window 30m)
3) run mapping backfill to remap events where external_sku exact matches configured mapping
4) run reconciliation job to compute net adjustments
Diego (Marketplace Integrations): hotfix branch pushed: eng-integrations PR #951. deploying to canary now.
Marketplace Bot: canary deploy started by @Diego (Marketplace Integrations) at 2025-11-02T01:12:10Z
Rishi (Billing): while canary runs i'll generate a small CSV sample for partner ops: `python tools/mkt_recon.py --customers 9 --window 2025-11-02T00:00:00Z/2025-11-02T02:00:00Z --output /tmp/gcp_sku_sample.csv`
Maya (Partnerships): thanks. i'll prep partner ops message with high-level summary, ask them to confirm SI sku naming, and include the sample csv. Eve i'll loop you in for wording.
Eve (Compliance): pls include the onboarding doc reference and note that this is a mapping alignment, not a pricing change.
Diego (Marketplace Integrations): canary metrics look good, no regressions in other sku mappings. rolling out to all shards in 20m.
Marketplace Bot: mapping backfill job completed \u2014 /tmp/mapping_backfill_1792500001.log
Rishi (Billing): reconciliation run complete. Candidate adjustments: 9 customers, 6 require credits, 3 require reallocations between entitlements. Total adjustment ~ $8,340. Details uploaded to /secure/gcp_sku_adjustments_1792500001.csv
Maya (Partnerships): perfect. i'll send partner ops a one-paragraph note and attach the csv. keep the tone neutral: "usage alignment adjustment".
Eve (Compliance): approved. for any customer > $5k we'll route through account escalation.
Rishi (Billing): I'll pause automated settlement for the affected billing window to avoid applying these rows until adjustments are confirmed. paused at 2025-11-02T02:40:00Z.
Maya (Partnerships): thx everyone. follow-ups: Diego to verify mapping config in partner onboarding docs, Rishi to file GL adjustments after partner confirmation, Eve to sign off on outbound copy. Closing once partner ops ack.
Marketplace Bot: ticket created: PARTNERS-6442 assigned to @Maya (Partnerships)
Maya (Partnerships): closing thread pending partner ack :wave:
